kinds.d: Program that removes junk files and tunes settings to keep a computer or phone clean and fast.
Program that removes installed applications together with their leftover files and settings.
Program that finds out-of-date device drivers and installs newer ones.
Program that creates, resizes, moves, merges and converts disk partitions.
Bundle of small system tools, such as window, file, keyboard and settings utilities, sold or given as one set rather than as a cleaner.

notes: Restraint-only. PC cleaner trimmed from 33 to 11 models (market brands plus built-in Storage Sense, open-source BleachBit and Android SD Maid SE); dropped misfiled AOMEI Partition Assistant and TotalAV Antivirus, Microsoft Total PC Cleaner, cloud/duplicate editions (CCleaner Cloud, Norton Utilities base), discontinued CleanMyPC and obscure tools; old ranges dropped (brand ranges belong in the brand register). Uninstaller 13->9. Driver updater 11->6 (dropped TweakBit, WinZip Driver Updater, Treexy, Driver Magician, 3DP Chip). Partition manager 26->12: kept current graphical, built-in and CLI tools plus PartitionMagic as the icon of the kind; dropped OS/2, Solaris, FreeDOS and other historic fdisk variants, FIPS, Ranish, DFSee, QtParted, ntfsresize, Parted Magic, GNU Parted (covered by GParted), duplicate DiskGenius. System utility suite: kept PowerToys, Windows Repair Toolbox, WinTools.net; Advanced System Optimizer, WinExt and XTR Toolbox are cleaners and dropped. No PUP flags added (none sourced). No new kinds needed.
